title: Fireplace Surround Kits - GenStone
text:
Turn Any Wall into a Stone Fireplace
Easier Than You Think • Faster Than You Expect

You don’t need venting, gas lines, or a contractor to get a real stone fireplace look.

With GenStone Fireplace Kits, you can build a full-wall or half-wall fireplace feature on almost any wall in your home, as long as you have access to a standard power outlet.

Most DIYers can complete this in a weekend.

What You Get in Every Kit

- All the GenStone needed to build the fireplace feature

- A premium electric fireplace insert

- DIY install instructions

- A step-by-step framing + install video

What Do You Provide

- Basic framing materials (the only thing not included)

- Common tools like a hand saw and drill

What Size Are the Fireplace Surround Kits?

The standard dimensions of each fireplace surround  kit is outlined below, but our team can quickly tell you how much more or less you need for your wall. Just tap Project SOS or give us a call.

Before You Start (Quick Checklist)

- Choose a wall with a nearby standard outlet

- Confirm you have room for the kit dimensions

- Gather framing materials + basic tools

Watch the videos. Pick your kit.
High-End Look • Low Skill Required

Bradford Fireplace Kit

The perfect “feature wall” size.

Best For: Living rooms, basements, bedrooms, and smaller spaces needing a focal point.

What it Builds: 53″ tall × 60″ wide fireplace feature

Electric Fireplace: 50″ (heats up to 400 sq. ft.)

Shaffer Fireplace Kit
